initLoc = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# --------------
# Create systems
# --------------

vehicle = veh.BMW_E90()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)

patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)

    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),

    vis.Advance(step_size)
    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# 1. Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())  # Ensure data path is set

# Create the physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# 2. Add the required physical systems and objects as specified

# Create the rigid terrain
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(system)

# Create a patch (flat terrain) with specified size and texture
patch = terrain.AddPatch(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1), 200, 200)
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
patch.SetMaterialSurface(veh.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC())
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/bmw_logo.png"), 10, 10)  # Custom logo texture on terrain

terrain.Initialize()

# Create the BMW E90 Sedan vehicle
vehicle = veh.BMW_E90_Sedan()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(veh.ChassisCollisionType_NONE)  # No chassis collision for simplicity
vehicle.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5), chrono.QUNIT))
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(1e-3)
vehicle.Initialize()

# Set visualization types
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)

# Create the interactive driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriver(vehicle)
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.04)   # steering increment per input
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.1)    # throttle increment per input
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.1)     # braking increment per input
driver.Initialize()

# 3. Set necessary default parameters such as positions, forces, and interactions

# Set the timestep size for the simulation
timestep = 1e-3

# Initialize the Irrlicht visualization system
application = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(vehicle.GetSystem(), "BMW E90 Sedan on Rigid Terrain", chronoirr.dimension2du(1280, 720))

# Add typical elements
application.AddTypicalSky()
application.AddTypicalLights()
application.AddTypicalCamera(chronoirr.vector3df(0, -8, 3))
application.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint=vehicle.GetChassisBody().GetPos(), chaseDistance=6.0, chaseHeight=1.5)

# Add directional light
light = application.GetDevice().getSceneManager().addLightSceneNode()
light.setPosition(chronoirr.vector3df(0, -10, 10))
light.setLightType(chrono.irrlicht.irr.LIGHT_DIRECTIONAL)
light.setDirection(chronoirr.vector3df(0, 1, -1))
light.setColor(chronoirr.SColorf(1.0, 1.0, 1.0))

# Add skybox with custom textures
application.AddTypicalSkyBox(veh.GetDataFile("skybox/sky_upward.jpg"),
                            veh.GetDataFile("skybox/sky_downward.jpg"),
                            veh.GetDataFile("skybox/sky_left.jpg"),
                            veh.GetDataFile("skybox/sky_right.jpg"),
                            veh.GetDataFile("skybox/sky_front.jpg"),
                            veh.GetDataFile("skybox/sky_back.jpg"))

# Bind all assets and start the simulation
application.AssetBindAll()
application.AssetUpdateAll()

# Simulation loop
while application.GetDevice().run():
    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()

    # Get driver inputs (interactive)
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
    # Apply driver inputs to vehicle
    vehicle.GetSteeringController().SetInput(driver_inputs.m_steering)
    vehicle.GetPowertrain().SetThrottle(driver_inputs.m_throttle)
    vehicle.GetBrakeController().SetInput(driver_inputs.m_braking)

    # Advance simulation by timestep
    driver.Synchronize(timestep)
    vehicle.Synchronize(driver.GetInputs(), terrain)
    terrain.Synchronize(vehicle.GetChassisBody().GetPos(), vehicle.GetChassisBody().GetRot())
    system.DoStepDynamics(timestep)

    application.EndScene()
```

```python
vehicle2 = veh.BMW_E90()

# Create the terrain (shared by both vehicles)
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()

patch = terrain.AddPatch(

# Change terrain texture from "tile4.jpg" to "concrete.jpg"
patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/concrete.jpg"), 200, 200)

vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()

driver1 = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1

driver1.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver1.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver1.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

print("VEHICLE 1 MASS: ", vehicle1.GetVehicle().GetMass())
print("VEHICLE 2 MASS: ", vehicle2.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle1.GetSystem().GetChTime()  # Both vehicles share the same system time

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs for vehicle1 from keyboard
    driver_inputs1 = driver1.GetInputs()

    # Generate sinusoidal steering input for vehicle2
    steering_amplitude = 0.5  # max steering angle normalized [-1,1]
    steering_frequency = 0.5  # Hz
    steering_input2 = steering_amplitude * math.sin(2 * math.pi * steering_frequency * time)

    # For vehicle2, throttle and braking inputs can be zero or constant
    throttle_input2 = 0.5  # moderate throttle
    braking_input2 = 0.0

    # Create a ChDriverInputs object for vehicle2
    driver_inputs2 = veh.DriverInputs()
    driver_inputs2.m_steering = steering_input2
    driver_inputs2.m_throttle = throttle_input2
    driver_inputs2.m_braking = braking_input2

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver1.Synchronize(time)
    driver2.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle1.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs1, terrain)
    vehicle2.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs2, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs1)  # Visualization uses driver1 inputs for camera control

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver1.Advance(step_size)
    driver2.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle1.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle2.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
